[b]WVAA Reaches New Heights with First Wessernian in Space[/b]
Yesterday, Sunday, March 19, 2028 at 12:32 Gary Ulysses Yuli, onboard a Traja rocket with the mission title Valmino-13 and a Pecario capsule, became the first Wessernian man to enter Erene orbit. He circled Erene 5 times and conducted 13 manned experiments as well as overseeing 5 unmanned ones, before reentering and landing in the Nestor Ocean to the west of South Vespuria. When he returned he was celebrated as a hero. As of right now several more manned missions and experiments are being planned as well as a capsule capable of holding multiple people and EVAs. Lastly John Fredrickson made a speech stating that the manned mission was a great success and that many more will soon follow. He also announced two new projects that the Wessernian population should look forward to: a space station and a mission to put a Wessernian on Dupont.

[b]March 14, 2028: The Femboy Question is Finally Answered[/b]
Well I want to congratulate you your honour, declared Cahit as he rolled into the office of the Shah, We have the necessary votes to ensure that the Femboy ideology is dealt with, the mullahs will thank you for centuries! declared Cahit with a joyous spreading of his hands, leaning slightly forward in his wheelchair.
It was a necessary step to regional security, and I am aware that security has become a big question, especially with the recent issues along the strait, there are rumors of terrorism arising once more in the South west of the shamats, it is easy to convince the party to lean one way if a policy is worded correctly, replied the Shah with a grim smile.
And you did it perfectly, intoned Cahit. I assume you will be meeting my counterpart in the Senate also? asked Cahit.
I will, at least I intend to, replied the shah.
Well, give him my best, replied Cahit, leaning forward once more before bidding the Shah adieu.

In the meantime, the Senate had convened to discuss the new bill which sat at them, it was a war powers resolution, a rare sight in the Senate, indeed once every decade an attempt would be made by some nationalist faction to get the nation to declare jihad or some other form of war in otrder to reclaim the title of Golden Caliphate, but those usually died quickly at the hand of the Shah, so it was odd to see the bill now laid out on the table.
The Chamber has requested that we speed this through, gentlemen, began Edis gravely.
I should wonder how they did so, chortled one of the Senators, slapping the table with his hand.
Edis frowned, It is now up to us, gentlemen, whether we allow thisshift, he intoned with a stern nod, Vote according to the national mandate, 
With that, 21 votes would be cast, 15 in favor of the passage of the mandate, 6 against. The bill to declare the Femboy threat a formal threat to the interests of Yzakastan would pass to a national referendum.

[b]WVAA is Pushed to Make Moon Landing Happen Quicker[/b]
Due to the fact that there have been no moon landings in a good amount of time, John Fredrickson and the Council of 13 has pushed for quicker advancements in the moon lading project, in fact, in a letter to the heads of the WVAA they suggested to move head scientists from the station project know as Utheropia (a reference to the town in the abyss (commonly thought of as outer space, yet is most likely not of this realm; inhospitable to any mortal being) in which those who have the purest of souls go onto when they die) and those who worked on the manned spacecraft but have been deemed "not necessary for the project" to move to working on the moon landing project called project Besikaluioty, more commonly referred to as project Besika. As of now the WVAA is moving some scientists over but certain members of the council have pushed for more to be moved to the moon project. Estimates think that by late 2029 to early 2030 is when Wesserns should expect to see a man on the moon, this is mostly because the Traja rocket already has a variant, known as the Traja-IX rocket, that is powerful enough to get a man to the moon and back on a crew of 4. There are already two Traja-IXs ready for launch, as well as 8 being constructed. The Traja-IX is massive, approximately 100 meters tall, and are very expensive, in fact almost all of tax payer money is going towards these rockets, but the public is, as of right now, ok with the use of their money for such massive and expensive rockets.

A Major step in Wellassona's integration into Erene!
[spoiler=Wellassona to join the Council of Independent Nations]
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Monday, 20 March 2028[/i]

Earlier today, Wellassona officially announced it would join the Council of Independent Nations.

The Council of Independent Nations, or COIN, is a supranational political, military, and economic alliance, whose stated goal is "creating a powerbloc of various nations against other alliances." It offers itself as an alternative to countries who are not interested in joining other major alliances, such as the EDU and THEP. Currently, the alliance is made up of the Flouesch Republic, Nevonia, and Yulandburg, with Wellassona intending to be the alliance's fourth member. This move is seen as a monumental step in Wellassona foreign relations, as Wellassona has historically been an isolationist and Neutral country, a remnant of its communist days.

Prime Minister Danil Sokolova stated in a press conference that he was [i]"Elated, to say the least,"[/i] that Wellassona was joining the COIN. [i]This is the culmination of my administration's efforts to connect Wellassona with the world, and I can say wholeheartedly that it has worked tremendously,"[/i] he added. Foreign Affairs minister Stanislava Poyanmovov was also supportive, calling it a [i]"big win,"[/i] and that Wellassona[i]"will be able to cooperate with other nations that share our goals."[/i]

There has been much pushback against the announcement. Leader of the Opposition Ipatiy Sergeev criticised the choice of alliance, calling the COIN [i]"Overtly fringe."[/i] He instead suggests Wellassona join the EDU, calling it [i]"A more organised and recognisable alliance that would benefiut us to a greater extent."[/i]. Valya Kulikov, leader of the far-right Reform the State party, called the announcement [i]"appallingly cruel,"[/i] claiming that [i]"Wellassona's heart and soul have been lost today thanks the the reckless actions of the communists that have endangered our nation."[/i] Despite the backlash from opposition groups, Wellassona is set to be the 4th member of the Confederation of Independent States, pending official approval from the Flouesch Republic.

The Diet voted in favour of joining the alliance 107 to 88, with the Senate subsequently approving it as well 20 to 16.

[/spoiler]
